# StartsWith

Tells whether text begins with a given prefix.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
StartsWith(text, prefix)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | The text to test. A number or a boolean is read as its string form, and null as the empty string. |
| `prefix` | string | The prefix to look for, matched exactly, case included. Every text begins with the empty string. |

## Returns

Boolean. True when text begins with prefix, false otherwise. Never null.

## Example

`StartsWith("filename.txt", "file")` returns true.
